variants.title: A · удлинённый овал
variants.prompt:
Create one original cinematic photograph of RITA, a fictional late-teen young woman approximately 18 years old from the science-fiction novel ALIVE. A normal everyday portrait before illness, quietly attentive and approachable with a steady thoughtful gaze, relaxed mouth, not smiling for a fashion advertisement. Simple modest practical clothing: a faded umber-brown long-sleeve work shirt with a few discreet repaired seams over a plain muted slate-blue crew-neck top, dark charcoal trousers. She stands comfortably holding a small plain enamel mug with both hands at waist height. Natural youthful facial features and realistic proportions, no makeup or glamour retouching. Setting: the Oval Base, a modest converted maintenance compartment in the lower levels of an old spacecraft made welcoming by its residents: repaired pale-grey metal walls with a FEW small hand-painted flowers and butterflies, repurposed table and chairs, a warm practical lamp. Understated lived-in hand-made details, not a fantasy palace or decorative cafe. No windows to Earth or space, no other people. Soft balanced photographic light with gentle warm accents, detailed natural skin and fabric. Horizontal 16:9 medium portrait: complete head and hair with headroom, full torso and forearms down to hips, eye-level normal lens. Face is the main focus. No text or collage. Each image is a different original casting option; no real actor likeness. Hair color, eye color, facial shape and skin tone vary according to the direction below; all share the same clothing, setting and composure.
CASTING DIRECTION: Fair neutral skin, dark ash-blond straight shoulder-length hair loosely tucked behind one ear, grey eyes, elongated oval face, high forehead, a distinctive narrow gently convex nose, fine straight brows, small square chin. Slight natural facial asymmetry, no polished beauty look.
